label: Greenline E-Drive
info:
# Greenline 6GK E-Drive

Passively decodes the electric drives from can0 and feeds two Victron virtual
`motordrive` devices (port = instance 210, stbd = 211).

Decode map verified against the MFD hybrid page 2026-08-17 (see `GreenlineFindings.md`):

    0x28x : [HCU/controller temp C,  MOTOR TEMP C]        11-bit CANopen, A=port B=stbd
    0x38x : [MOTOR VOLTAGE V,        PHASE CURRENT RMS A]
    0x48x : [MOTOR TORQUE N.m,       MOTOR RPM]           <-- torque, NOT power x100W
    0x18x : status byte, 01 = running

    61451 0x14F00Bxx  byte1 - 125 = torque %      SA 0x64=stbd, 0x65=port
    61452 0x14F00Cxx  w2 -> DC current, w4/20 = phase current peak A
    65363 0x18FF53xx  byte0 = instance, bytes1-2 LE / 9.280 = THROTTLE %
    127493            byte0 = instance, byte1 bits0-1 gear (0xFC Fwd, 0xFD Neutral, 0xFE Rev)

## Victron motordrive properties - all 9, and what feeds them

| dbus path                | source                          |
|--------------------------|---------------------------------|
| Dc/0/Voltage             | 0x38x f1                        |
| Dc/0/Current             | 61452 w2 (measured)             |
| Dc/0/Power               | Dc/0/Voltage x Dc/0/Current     |
| Motor/RPM                | 0x48x f2                        |
| Motor/Temperature        | 0x28x f2                        |
| Controller/Temperature   | 0x28x f1                        |
| Motor/Direction          | 127493 gear                     |
| Connected                | frame staleness (6 s)           |
| Coolant/Temperature      | 61453 - OFF, scale unverified   |

No dbus path exists for torque (N.m or %), throttle %, or phase current: those go
out of output 3 for Signal K / MQTT if wanted.

The 2 s tick inject exists so `Connected` drops to 0 when the bus goes silent -
without it the last values freeze forever (the drives were showing a stale 22.7 V
after shutdown before this was added).
